message.content:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate** options you can use right away:

- **YourMechanic** — free instant estimates with a parts-and-labor breakdown; you can also book a mobile mechanic after getting the quote.[1]
- **RepairPal** — free car repair estimates based on your vehicle and zip code, with fair-price ranges and certified-shop pricing.[2]
- **NAPA Auto Care Repair Estimator** — quick estimates for common repairs and maintenance; it notes that the result is only an estimate and recommends an in-person inspection for an exact quote.[3]
- **AAA Auto Repair Estimate** — provides parts, labor, and member-discount breakdowns for AAA Approved Auto Repair facilities.[4]
- **Caliber online estimate** — free initial online estimates for auto body, collision, and glass repair.[5]
- **Openbay** — lets you describe the issue and zip code to compare quotes from local repair professionals.[6]
- **Kelley Blue Book Auto Repair Pricing** — free estimator showing a local “Fair Repair Range” for common repairs and maintenance.[7]

If you want, I can also help you choose the **best one for your repair type**:
- **mechanical repair**
- **collision/body repair**
- **glass repair**
- **mobile mechanic quotes**
